vocab_words.example: The company reported a budget surplus this year.
Real estate is considered a valuable asset.

vocab_words.meaning: đối tượng khách hàng mục tiêu
vocab_words.example: Our target audience is young professionals.
The brand secured a celebrity endorsement.
Customers receive a discount for early payment.
The brochure describes all our services.

vocab_words.meaning: hoạt động tiếp cận (khách hàng, cộng đồng)
vocab_words.example: The team increased its community outreach efforts.
Over fifty applicants applied for the position.

vocab_words.meaning: quá trình hòa nhập nhân viên mới
vocab_words.example: The onboarding process takes about one week.

items.question: This is one of the ___ effective marketing strategies we have used.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh nhất "one of the most + adj".

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor event ___ as scheduled.
items.explanation: Câu kể lại sự việc đã xảy ra trong quá khứ nên dùng thì quá khứ đơn.

items.question: The board of directors ___ meet next Tuesday to discuss the merger.
items.explanation: Diễn tả một sự kiện sẽ diễn ra trong tương lai, dùng "will + V nguyên mẫu".

items.question: It is essential that all staff ___ the new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: Câu giả định sau "it is essential that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: Ms. Tran has worked at this company ___ 2019.
items.explanation: "Since + mốc thời gian" (2019) diễn tả hành động bắt đầu từ thời điểm đó tới nay.

items.question: Employees are required to submit their timesheets ___ Friday afternoon.
items.explanation: "By" mang nghĩa hạn chót (deadline) — phải nộp trước hoặc đúng thời điểm đó.

items.question: The negotiation process took longer ___ anyone had anticipated.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn dùng "than", không phải "then".

items.question: The company's profits have grown steadily ___ the past five years.
items.explanation: "Over the past + khoảng thời gian" diễn tả một quá trình kéo dài.

items.question: She is responsible ___ managing the entire logistics department.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be responsible for + V-ing/danh từ".
